notes: Network was available and the strict literature check ran (6 of 12 queries). I could not run integrity_scan.py because the evaluation rules allow only the aggregation and related_search scripts, so I searched the text by hand for reviewer-directed text and found none. The skill has no instruction for this case. Figures were unavailable, so curve-based claims (Figs. 2, 4, 7-9) are judged from captions and text. The skill says to start EIC weights at 1.0 and move them only for verified reasons; I moved only R1 (1.25). The DA table for criterion 3 (selection) is written for test-set selection and fits TOFU awkwardly (no validation split, forget set is also the training set), so I treated selection as MAJOR and used criterion 2 (evaluation on the training inputs of the proposed term) for the CRITICAL issue. The ICLR label printed for final Overall 3 is '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}', which reads as a different number than the internal 3; the dual vocabulary is easy to misread. The aggregate script and the review text both rely on pool-position bands that conflict slightly with an Overall of 4 for pool positions in the mid-60s (the script shows pool bands 55-61 for 66-68). Writing five reports in one context is hard to keep independent; I read the whole paper once and then wrote each report from a distinct angle.
